title: myGrape Genie
content: Hi, Welcome to mgSCALE, I'm the care taker of the lab. I understand that you are here to learn how to use mgSCALE. That's a right choice! with mgSCALE most of your burden are automated. I'll walk you through on how it's possible.

title: KPI Pulse
content: This is your embryologist's command centre. Every KPI shown here is tailored to what you need to act on storage volumes, container health, and deviations all in one view the moment you log in.

title: KPI Pulse
content: These metrics are retrieved directly from your hospital's data systems, representing verified, real-time inventory rather than manual records. Any discrepancy between these values and your laboratory documentation requires immediate review.

title: Total Cryolocks
content: This metric displays the total number of Cryolocks currently stored across all sites. Since Cryolocks contain vitrified embryos, this count reflects your active inventory and should align with your laboratory records.

title: Total Containers
content: This metric shows the total number of cryogenic containers (tanks) actively monitored. Each container holds multiple Cryolocks, tracking this number helps you manage storage capacity and flag any unregistered units.

title: KPI Pulse
content: A single overlooked deviation or an unmonitored container can compromise a patient's only viable embryos. These KPIs exist so that never happens on your watch, turning complex lab data into a clear signal you can act on in seconds.

title: Container Performance
content: This panel shows which cryogenic containers have triggered quality deviations and highlights their primary drivers, enabling you to prioritize which units require immediate inspection.

title: Container Performance
content: Each card shows the deviation count alongside the top driver, so you know not just how many issues exist, but exactly what is causing them. Repeated drivers across containers signal a systemic problem worth escalating.

title: Quality Deviations Flagged
content: The total number of quality deviations currently flagged across all monitored containers. This includes the ones that are active alerts or acknowledged ones. This number here says that mgSCALE has cautioned you on deviations.

title: Top Deviation Driver
content: This card displays the single biggest cause of container deviations right now, whether it's a temperature excursion, low LN2, or a lid state issue. Focus your attention here to address the most recurring problem.

title: Container Performance
content: Unresolved container deviations don't just affect equipment, they also put stored embryos and genetic material at direct risk. Catching a temperature breach or low LN2 level here means an unrecoverable incident and irreversible loss have been prevented.

title: Incubator Performance
content: Incubator stability is critical for embryo development. This panel surfaces deviations and their top causes so your lab team can act before culture conditions are compromised.

title: Incubator Performance
content: Even a brief temperature fluctuation inside an incubator can impair embryo development at a cellular level. The deviation count and top driver here give your lab team the earliest possible signal, so corrective action happens in minutes, not hours.

title: Incubator Quality Deviations
content: The number of quality deviations flagged inside your incubators. Unlike container deviations, incubator issues directly affect live culture, so each flagged deviation here should be traced to a specific chamber and resolved before the next culture check.

title: Incubator Top Deviation Driver
content: This card shows us the leading cause of incubator deviations right now. CO₂ fluctuations, humidity drops, and door seal failures are common culprits, and knowing the driver lets you go straight to the right corrective protocol instead of running a full diagnostic.

title: Incubator Performance
content: Every embryo in culture right now is depending on these conditions staying stable. Any flagged deviation here would have reduced blastocyst development rates, lower implantation success, and in the worst case, mean a patient has no viable embryos left for transfer.

title: Quality Tracking
content: Jump directly into Cryocan Quality Tracking, Embryo Grading, or Incubator Quality Tracking from here. These are your everyday tools for logging and verifying sample integrity.

title: Cryocan Quality Tracking
content: Click this card to open the Cryocan Quality Tracking tool and check the storage health of your liquid nitrogen tanks.

title: Track Cryocan Quality
content: This panel allows you to enter a tank code to retrieve its live status which includes temperature, lid state, and LN2 levels. For this walkthrough, simply close the panel when you are ready to continue.

title: Deviation Distribution
content: This chart breaks down every deviation type across your sites, including Battery Level, Lid State, LN2, Evaporation Rate, Temperature, and Shock Detection. Spot patterns across sites at a glance.

title: Live Alerts
content: Live alerts that need your attention. Staying on top of this list keeps your samples and patients safe.

title: Critical Alerts
content: The red badge here means something needs immediate action, such as a tank temperature breach, a missing check, or an escalated deviation. Click the icon to review what's critical right now.

title: Critical Alerts Panel
content: Each card here represents an unresolved critical event. Review the details, take the necessary action in the lab, and acknowledge the alert to clear it from the queue. Close this panel to continue.

title: Stakeholder Chats
content: This chat feature enables seamless collaboration with clinicians, embryologists, and operations teams directly within the platform. Click the chat icon to view pending conversations.

title: Stakeholder Chats Panel
content: Each thread is linked to a Cryocan, keeping communications traceable and auditable. Reply directly here to keep everyone aligned. Close this panel to continue.

title: My Tasks
content: Your personal task queue lists scheduled QC checks, follow up tasks, and action items assigned to you. Click the icon to see what's pending.

title: My Tasks Panel
content: Mark tasks complete as you work through them. Overdue items are highlighted so nothing slips through, especially for embryo or cryostorage workflows that are time sensitive. Close this panel to continue.

title: Site Level Information
content: This table provides a real-time overview of key metrics for every laboratory site across your network. You can monitor data from all locations simultaneously and utilize filters to isolate specific details directly within a single interface.
